# copick sync tiltseries

<span class="source-badge source-badge--core" title="Part of copick core">core</span>

*Synchronize tilt series between two Copick projects.*

## Usage

```bash
copick sync tiltseries [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Copies tilt series, images and metadata, from a source Copick project to a target project. The metadata is stored
with each copy, so tilt series of the CryoET Data Portal (`--source-dataset-ids`) carry their per-image angles,
dose and CTF in the target. `--with-alignments` copies their alignments too.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--source-dataset-ids` | text | `""` | Comma-separated list of dataset IDs to use as source from CryoET Data Portal. If provided, --config will be ignored and a temporary dataportal configuration will be created. |
| `--target-config` | path | **required** | Path to the target configuration file. |
| `--source-runs` | text | `""` | Comma-separated list of source run names to synchronize. If not specified, all runs will be synced. |
| `--target-runs` | text | `""` | Comma-separated mapping of source run names to target run names (e.g. 'run1:target1,run2:target2'). If not specified, source run names will be used. |
| `--source-ts-types` | text | `""` | Comma-separated list of source tilt series types to synchronize. If not specified, all tilt series will be synced. |
| `--target-ts-types` | text | `""` | Comma-separated mapping of source tilt series types to target types (e.g. 'raw:original'). If not specified, source types will be used. |
| `--with-alignments / --no-with-alignments` | boolean flag | `False` | Also synchronize the alignments of each tilt series. |
| `--exist-ok / --no-exist-ok` | boolean flag | `False` | Allow overwriting existing objects in the target project. |
| `--max-workers` | integer | `4` | Maximum number of worker threads to use for synchronization. |
| `--log / --no-log` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable verbose logging of the synchronization process. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
# Copy the tilt series and alignments of two portal datasets into a local project
copick sync tiltseries --source-dataset-ids 10445,10446 --target-config local.json --with-alignments

# Copy raw tilt series under another type
copick sync tiltseries -c source.json --target-config target.json --source-ts-types raw \
    --target-ts-types raw:original
```
